newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds thinned by strong dollar.
newsitem.headline: European feeds thinned by strong dollar.

text.p: European meals and feeds remained thinly traded on Thursday as the strong dollar and prospect of jittery Chicago markets combined to keep many consumers sidelined, traders said.
Sellers offered products at mixed levels this morning but the U.S. currency level discouraged activity. Consumer demand was likely to remain confined to nearby positions, traders said.

U.S. futures were sharply higher early and the May and July contracts were in fast dealings on hefty fund buying, where stronger than expected U.S. Agriculture Department export sales also lent support. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
